jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates within the defense logistics sector, supporting data management and standardization efforts critical to defense operations. It addresses challenges related to data element evaluation, business rule application, and the implementation of data standards to enhance operational efficiency and data integrity within the Department of the Navy (DoN).

2. About the Opportunity:
The Data Analyst\ role is responsible for providing technical expertise in evaluating data elements, codes, and business rules, ensuring clarity and accuracy in data definitions as they relate to business processes. This position supports the development and implementation of data strategies and policies that meet the organization’s information needs, contributing to standardized and effective data management within defense logistics.

3. Responsibilities:
• Provide technical support in evaluating data elements, codes, business rules, and data standards.
• Evaluate proposed data elements, codes, and their attributes.
• Ensure proposed data definitions are clear, concise, technically correct, and accurately represented in business processes.
• Collect business and data requirements and perform data analysis.
• Develop data strategy and associated policies and procedures.
• Implement capabilities to meet business information needs.
• Communicate accurate information effectively.

4. Requirements:
• Ten years of relevant experience, including extensive review and coordination of policies, vocabularies, and data elements used throughout the Department of the Navy.
• Experience with standards and technologies such as Accredited Standards Committee (ASC) X12, Business Enterprise Architecture, data dictionaries, data warehousing, enterprise application integration, metadata registry, Master Data Management (MDM), relational databases, Semantics, data retention, SQL, Procedural SQL, XML (including schema definitions and transformations).
• Extensive experience representing Department of the Navy interests in the ASC X12 data standards management process.
• Possession of IT-II Non-Critical Sensitive or Tier 3 security clearance.

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• Salary range: $95,000 to $140,000.

6. Benefits & Perks:
• Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans with PPO and HSA options.
• Flexible Spending Accounts for Health Care and Dependent Care.
• Health Savings Account.
• 401(k) with matching contributions.
• Roth.
• Qualified Transportation Expense with matching contributions.
• Short Term and Long Term Disability.
• Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance.
• Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance.
• Wellness Program.
• Paid Time Off.
• 11 Holidays.
• Professional Development Reimbursement.

jobs.title: Advanced Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Agilent, we are committed to advancing the quality of life by delivering trusted answers and insights that empower our customers to make impactful decisions. Join us at the forefront of our data transformation journey, where your expertise will help shape the next generation of analytics platforms and drive business value through actionable insights.

We are seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our global analytics team. In this role, you will play a key part in our transition to a modern data ecosystem, leveraging Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Snowflake.

You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions while supporting the migration and modernization of our existing analytics portfolio.

This role requires a strong balance of technical expertise, business acumen, and stakeholder engagement
to ensure successful adoption and value realization.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with business stakeholders (Sales, Services, Marketing) to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable solutions.
Drive the design and development of dashboards and data products using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
Contribute to analytics platform migration and modernization efforts, ensuring continuity and improvement of analytical capabilities.
Develop and maintain data models leveraging Snowflake and modern data architectures.
Define technical requirements and data structures to support analytics use cases.
Apply statistical analysis and visualization techniques to generate actionable insights.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across analytics solutions.
Create and maintain documentation, including dashboard definitions and user training materials.
Collaborate across IT, data engineering, and business teams to align on data architecture and priorities.
Act as a trusted advisor to drive data literacy and adoption of new analytics platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or related roles.
Strong, proven hands-on experience with:
Microsoft Power BI (e.g., data modeling, DAX queries, creating dashboards/reports using enterprise data)
Microsoft Fabric
Programming experience (e.g., SQL Python)
Experience with business intelligence tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Spotfire) is a plus.
Experience with business intelligence platform migrations to Power BI/establishing Power BI environments is highly desirable.
Understanding of enterprise data systems (e.g., SAP, CRM) and data integration concepts.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a global environment.
Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation.
Experience working in cross-functional and transformation-driven environments.
Self-driven, structured, and comfortable operating in evolving environments.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least July 23, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.

The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $74,560.00 - $139,800.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics
jobs.description:
Back to jobs

New

Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics

New York

Join ShopMy – Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst
to join ShopMy’s growing Data & Analytics team and become a dedicated analytics partner to Product, Engineering, and Design. This role is about helping every product perform to its potential: establishing what success looks like, ensuring the right behaviors are tracked, validating launches, and making it easy to see what’s working, what isn’t, and where the next opportunity lies.

You know how to identify what drives value and unlock it through better measurement, systems, and analysis. You don’t wait for every question to be handed to you. You dig into user behavior, conversion funnels, product performance, and user feedback to find gaps and opportunities, then work with the right teams to act on them. When data is missing, inconsistent, or misleading, you trace the issue to its source and help drive a complete solution.

You bring substantial technical depth and strong product intuition. You can think in SQL, build thoughtful data models, create dashboards that tell a clear story, and translate nuanced findings into clear recommendations. You know that technically correct results can still tell the wrong story, and you have the judgment to recognize when the data does not reflect the user behavior or business question it is meant to explain. You use AI to multiply your output without outsourcing your judgment.

ShopMy sits at the intersection of SaaS, e-commerce, and a multi-sided marketplace, creating an unusually broad product analytics problem space. You’ll work across creator, brand, and shopper experiences, help define how we measure AI-powered products, and explore how AI can continuously monitor performance, surface anomalies, and generate insights. This is a high-autonomy role with a direct line from your work to ShopMy’s product decisions and business performance.

What You’ll Do

Own product analytics for key areas, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Design to define success criteria, tracking requirements, and measurement plans from discovery through launch and optimization
Build and maintain product data models, dashboards, and analyses that make adoption, conversion funnels, user behavior, product performance, and opportunities clear and actionable
Validate launches and monitor live products, creating alerts and quality checks that identify instrumentation gaps, product regressions, anomalous behavior, and data issues early
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify, quantify, and prioritize opportunities that improve product performance and drive business impact
Design and evaluate experimentation and measurement strategies, including A/B testing, incrementality, and attribution
Audit product tracking across web and mobile sources, events, and transformations, partnering with Data Infrastructure and Engineering to resolve gaps and build the models or pipelines needed for reliable analysis
Help measure and improve AI-powered products, and develop AI-enabled analytics workflows that monitor performance, interpret feedback, and surface insights at scale
Communicate clear recommendations, challenge assumptions when needed, and quantify the impact of product and analytics initiatives for stakeholders and leadership

Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in product analytics within e-commerce, marketplaces, B2B SaaS, marketing technology, agencies, social platforms, or similarly relevant environments
Expert SQL skills with experience working with large, complex datasets, building data models and pipelines, and operating within modern cloud data warehouses
Strong experience with business intelligence tools, BI modeling, data visualization, and storytelling through dashboards
Experience analyzing digital user behavior, conversion funnels, feature adoption, and product performance; defining instrumentation and measurement plans; and working with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Heap, Mixpanel, or similar platforms
Experience with experimentation and measurement, including A/B testing, incrementality, or attribution
Working experience with Python, JavaScript, R, notebooks, or similar tools for analysis and automation, along with experience using AI to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, monitor products, or surface insights
Strong product intuition, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail, with a resourceful and self-directed approach to ambiguity, prioritization, and independently identifying where Analytics should get involved
Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner who can simplify abstract or technical concepts, tailor the message to the audience, and turn analysis into a clear point of view

We have a strong preference for someone to be based in New York City, but open to remote on the East Coast.

The work in this role directly shapes how ShopMy builds, measures, and improves its products. This is foundational, high-impact work with meaningful autonomy, exposure across the full product portfolio, and the opportunity to define what excellent product analytics looks like as the company scales.

In compliance with New York Pay Transparency Law, the salary range for this position is as shown. We note that salary information as a general guideline only, actual compensation may vary from posting based on the offer for this role, including the scope and responsibilities of the position, relevant work experience, key skills, education, training and business considerations.

New York Pay Range

$125,000 - $175,000 USD

The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of bonus potential or commission and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. ShopMy is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of ShopMy receives equity on top of cash compensation!

ShopMy offers a bundle of benefits on top of being a great place to work.

Our Teammates Are Provided Benefits Such As

Medical & Dental Coverage at 70%
Equity in ShopMy

14 weeks of parental leave

Job Description

At Agilent, we are committed to advancing the quality of life by delivering trusted answers and insights that empower our customers to make impactful decisions. Join us at the forefront of our data transformation journey, where your expertise will help shape the next generation of analytics platforms and drive business value through actionable insights.

We are seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our global analytics team. In this role, you will play a key part in our transition to a modern data ecosystem, leveraging Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Snowflake.

You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions while supporting the migration and modernization of our existing analytics portfolio.

This role requires a strong balance of technical expertise, business acumen, and stakeholder engagement
to ensure successful adoption and value realization.

Key Responsibilities:

Partner with business stakeholders (Sales, Services, Marketing) to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable solutions.
Drive the design and development of dashboards and data products using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
Contribute to analytics platform migration and modernization efforts, ensuring continuity and improvement of analytical capabilities.
Develop and maintain data models leveraging Snowflake and modern data architectures.
Define technical requirements and data structures to support analytics use cases.
Apply statistical analysis and visualization techniques to generate actionable insights.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across analytics solutions.
Create and maintain documentation, including dashboard definitions and user training materials.
Collaborate across IT, data engineering, and business teams to align on data architecture and priorities.
Act as a trusted advisor to drive data literacy and adoption of new analytics platforms.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or related roles.
Strong, proven hands-on experience with:
Microsoft Power BI (e.g., data modeling, DAX queries, creating dashboards/reports using enterprise data)
Microsoft Fabric
Programming experience (e.g., SQL Python)
Experience with business intelligence tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Spotfire) is a plus.
Experience with business intelligence platform migrations to Power BI/establishing Power BI environments is highly desirable.
Understanding of enterprise data systems (e.g., SAP, CRM) and data integration concepts.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a global environment.
Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation.
Experience working in cross-functional and transformation-driven environments.
Self-driven, structured, and comfortable operating in evolving environments.

new_jobs.description:
Back to jobs

New

Senior Data Analyst, Product Analytics

New York

Join ShopMy – Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst
to join ShopMy’s growing Data & Analytics team and become a dedicated analytics partner to Product, Engineering, and Design. This role is about helping every product perform to its potential: establishing what success looks like, ensuring the right behaviors are tracked, validating launches, and making it easy to see what’s working, what isn’t, and where the next opportunity lies.

You know how to identify what drives value and unlock it through better measurement, systems, and analysis. You don’t wait for every question to be handed to you. You dig into user behavior, conversion funnels, product performance, and user feedback to find gaps and opportunities, then work with the right teams to act on them. When data is missing, inconsistent, or misleading, you trace the issue to its source and help drive a complete solution.

You bring substantial technical depth and strong product intuition. You can think in SQL, build thoughtful data models, create dashboards that tell a clear story, and translate nuanced findings into clear recommendations. You know that technically correct results can still tell the wrong story, and you have the judgment to recognize when the data does not reflect the user behavior or business question it is meant to explain. You use AI to multiply your output without outsourcing your judgment.

ShopMy sits at the intersection of SaaS, e-commerce, and a multi-sided marketplace, creating an unusually broad product analytics problem space. You’ll work across creator, brand, and shopper experiences, help define how we measure AI-powered products, and explore how AI can continuously monitor performance, surface anomalies, and generate insights. This is a high-autonomy role with a direct line from your work to ShopMy’s product decisions and business performance.

What You’ll Do

Own product analytics for key areas, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Design to define success criteria, tracking requirements, and measurement plans from discovery through launch and optimization
Build and maintain product data models, dashboards, and analyses that make adoption, conversion funnels, user behavior, product performance, and opportunities clear and actionable
Validate launches and monitor live products, creating alerts and quality checks that identify instrumentation gaps, product regressions, anomalous behavior, and data issues early
Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify, quantify, and prioritize opportunities that improve product performance and drive business impact
Design and evaluate experimentation and measurement strategies, including A/B testing, incrementality, and attribution
Audit product tracking across web and mobile sources, events, and transformations, partnering with Data Infrastructure and Engineering to resolve gaps and build the models or pipelines needed for reliable analysis
Help measure and improve AI-powered products, and develop AI-enabled analytics workflows that monitor performance, interpret feedback, and surface insights at scale
Communicate clear recommendations, challenge assumptions when needed, and quantify the impact of product and analytics initiatives for stakeholders and leadership

Qualifications

4+ years of experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in product analytics within e-commerce, marketplaces, B2B SaaS, marketing technology, agencies, social platforms, or similarly relevant environments
Expert SQL skills with experience working with large, complex datasets, building data models and pipelines, and operating within modern cloud data warehouses
Strong experience with business intelligence tools, BI modeling, data visualization, and storytelling through dashboards
Experience analyzing digital user behavior, conversion funnels, feature adoption, and product performance; defining instrumentation and measurement plans; and working with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Heap, Mixpanel, or similar platforms
Experience with experimentation and measurement, including A/B testing, incrementality, or attribution
Working experience with Python, JavaScript, R, notebooks, or similar tools for analysis and automation, along with experience using AI to accelerate analysis, automate workflows, monitor products, or surface insights
Strong product intuition, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail, with a resourceful and self-directed approach to ambiguity, prioritization, and independently identifying where Analytics should get involved
Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner who can simplify abstract or technical concepts, tailor the message to the audience, and turn analysis into a clear point of view

We have a strong preference for someone to be based in New York City, but open to remote on the East Coast.

The work in this role directly shapes how ShopMy builds, measures, and improves its products. This is foundational, high-impact work with meaningful autonomy, exposure across the full product portfolio, and the opportunity to define what excellent product analytics looks like as the company scales.

In compliance with New York Pay Transparency Law, the salary range for this position is as shown. We note that salary information as a general guideline only, actual compensation may vary from posting based on the offer for this role, including the scope and responsibilities of the position, relevant work experience, key skills, education, training and business considerations.

New York Pay Range

$125,000 - $175,000 USD

The provided salary range is base salary, exclusive of bonus potential or commission and is a good faith estimate of cash compensation. ShopMy is flexible pending candidate's experience and how our business needs evolve throughout the search. Every employee of ShopMy receives equity on top of cash compensation!

ShopMy offers a bundle of benefits on top of being a great place to work.

Over the past six decades, we’ve built Kiely Family of Companies to focus on customer success and design-build capabilities. We rely on a culture of teamwork, technological innovation and high ethical standards to deliver successful solutions to our customers.

Kiely Family of Companies, established in 1952 by John F. Kiely Sr., contributes to something far greater than itself, as each company’s unique capabilities enhance the others, making us greater than the sum of our parts.

ENR 500 and 600 ranked for engineering and construction, KIELY serves the needs of our customers, offering a diversified list of services, such as full-service engineering, utility construction, heavy highway, hot mix asphalt production, equipment sales and leasing, recycling services, and residential and commercial building, leasing, and maintenance.

Kiely serves a purpose much larger than any individual, project, or entity. We refer to our employees as team members because together we empower, partner, and advance. Our team members are an elite group of behind-the-scenes professionals who embody Kiely’s core values.

Position Summary

M'Oherron Company, a division of Kiely Family of Companies is looking for an Project Coordinator who will be responsible for assisting the Construction Supervisors and supporting the Foreman by coordinating the activities of the project ensuring safety, quality, cost, schedule, and documentation requirements are met.

Responsibilities

Follow up on collection of all non-received documents and escalate any issues to the Supervisor.
Collect foreman daily reports, weekly project pictures and safety documentation, review for completeness and include in project documentation. Inform Supervisor of deficiencies.
Assist team members with payroll/ timecard related concerns.
Prioritize workload while working on multiple projects / tasks
Prepare, collect and distribute billing documentation for projects
Support Project Leaders / Project Managers as needed

Competencies

3-5 years of construction experience with a degree in construction management or an engineering field being a plus.
The ability to become well versed in the Company’s safety program procedures and policies, follows/enforces said policies/makes tough decisions to ensure the safety remains on the forefront of the business.
College Degree in construction management, architecture, engineering or equivalent experience
Current Project Management certification(s)
Strong working knowledge of Timberline, and CMS
Three (3) years of senior level administrative experience while managing complex tasks or projects
Knowledge of Excel, Timberline, and CMS

Equal Opportunity Employee, M/F/D/V

Kiely Family of Companies is a growing and dynamic company actively seeking applications and resumes from exceptional candidates. Whether you come equipped with years of experience in the underground utility field—or you’re ready to work hard and get there—we want to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Healthcare and Pharmaceutical Agency
new_jobs.description:
1. About Our Client:
The organization operates within the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector, addressing the complexities of project management in life sciences marketing and communications. It supports clients through managing projects that involve coordination across multiple teams and disciplines, aiming to deliver quality outcomes within regulated frameworks. The entity handles programs with budgets ranging from $1 million to $2 million, reflecting a considerable scale of operations.

2. About the Opportunity:
The Project Coordinator role is designed to support and advance project initiatives from start to finish, ensuring timelines, budgets, and quality standards are met. This position contributes to maintaining effective workflows and communication across teams, facilitating project success and operational efficiency. It offers foundational experience in project management crucial for career growth within this sector.

3. Responsibilities:
• Support daily project activities including timelines, status reports, and project routing
• Collaborate with team members to maintain communication and anticipate challenges
• Assist with project setup, tracking, and reporting using project management tools
• Support programs with budgets between $1M and $2M, potentially managing smaller budgets with oversight
• Perform administrative duties as required, up to 50% of the time
• Assist in budget tracking and reporting to ensure accuracy and profitability
• Participate in mentorship and training to develop operational and collaborative skills
• Promote adherence to workplace values such as client service, accountability, and collaboration
• Schedule and facilitate internal meetings for status updates and project kickoffs
• Provide proactive updates on timelines and resourcing under guidance
• Learn agency frameworks, client requirements, and regulatory processes
• Help resolve workflow challenges to maintain efficiency and accountability
• Foster candid communication and trust during project planning and execution
• Observe and learn risk identification and mitigation, contributing to issue escalation
• Engage in onboarding and continuous training on agency processes and project management best practices
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support a positive, team-oriented environment

4. Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, advertising, or related field preferred
• Minimum of 1 year of professional experience preferred
• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences fields is a plus
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Mac operating system
• Strong collaboration, adaptability, initiative, and accountability skills

5. Pay Range and Compensation Package:
• Estimated salary range: $40,000 to $60,000 USD
• Eligible for discretionary annual bonus
• Includes health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off

6. Benefits & Perks:
• Health insurance
• Retirement savings benefits
• Life insurance
• Disability benefits
• Parental leave
• Paid time off for sick leave and vacation
